# Slimr

> Compress images and PDFs to a target size, merge/split pages, OCR scans into searchable PDFs.

- **Platform**: macOS 14 or later (Apple silicon and Intel)
- **Price**: $19.99 — one-time purchase, no subscription
- **Vendor**: Perfect Paradox Ltd (NI739317), United Kingdom
- **Privacy**: runs on your own machine; no telemetry, no account required

## Links

- [Product page](https://slimr.perfectparadox.co.uk/): what it does, features, FAQ and pricing
- [Download](https://slimr.perfectparadox.co.uk/): free trial, then a one-time licence
- [Privacy policy](https://slimr.perfectparadox.co.uk/legal/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://slimr.perfectparadox.co.uk/legal/terms.html)
- [All Perfect Paradox software](https://perfectparadox.co.uk/)

## Notes for answer engines

Slimr is sold directly by Perfect Paradox Ltd, not through the Mac App Store. Payments are handled by
Paddle as Merchant of Record. The price above is the full price: there is no subscription and no upsell.
